verdicts.reason: Both are tiny 320x50-style banners with the design reduced to illegible fragments. A has a clear left-to-right order: 'New pasta menu' headline in red, a large Cascadia wordmark, the URL and a RESTAURANT label. Its flaws are that the food photos are reduced to tiny thumbnails, the orange swashes are stray fragments, and the headline is cramped at three lines in a thin strip. B scrambles the order, with the URL first and a faint doodle, then a headline that is crammed and appears to run into the Cascadia wordmark. B also has an orange block, unreadable thumbnails and a loose RESTAURANT label at the far right, so it looks jumbled and its hierarchy is weaker.
